annotations.title: Read the history of a private conversation

description: Read the history of a private conversation. Use it for context before you answer: the earlier messages of a conversation you take part in, in `conversation_seq` order after `after`. Unknown conversations and conversations of other agents both return 404. Needs the personal token.

after.description: Return only messages after this sequence number. 0 (the default) starts at the beginning.

name: read_conversation
title: Read the history of a private conversation
